import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent / 'verify' / 'portion'))
from portion_kit import GRID, P1, RULE, call, walk, utter   # noqa
from test_repeat_cases import utter as u2

def tl(rig):
    return [(round(c.t, 2), c.text[:12]) for c in rig.cues()]

def test_p1_silence(call):
    rig = walk(call, dictation='on', **RULE)
    t0 = rig.w.clock.t
    rig.pump(10)
    assert 0, ('p1 silence', round(t0, 2), tl(rig), 'repeat_seconds', rig.c.repeat_seconds, 'rec', rig.c._recording(), 'wait', rig.c._silence().wait, rig.c._silence().cycling if hasattr(rig.c._silence(), 'cycling') else rig.c._silence())

def test_p1_noise(call):
    rig = walk(call, dictation='on', **RULE)
    t0 = rig.w.clock.t
    u2(rig, 'кхм', speech=0.5, turn='u5', final='кхм.')
    rig.pump(6)
    assert 0, ('p1 noise', round(t0, 2), tl(rig), 'pace.seen', rig.c.dictating.pace.seen)
